description: The 12ui Design plugin for Claude Code.

plugins.name: 12ui-design
plugins.description: A Design workspace in Claude Code: see design options for a UI as images, select one, ask for more, ask for a change with a note and hand an option off to be built. Your agent runs the 12ui command line once per request, which draws every option at once with your own Codex sign-in.
